data.content_ref: inline:Two faults. (1) Empty simulation_refs: the mechanism describes 'implementing a local search simulation' to map the neighborhood graph, but no sandboxed simulation is filed; per the problem statement this is an unverified prose claim. (2) The hypothesis is logically premature and non-discriminating: if S(13)=45 (i.e., no 44-comparator network exists), then 44-networks form an empty set and 'disconnected component' is vacuously true but explanatorily empty — the claim cannot distinguish 'landscape ruggedness' from 'non-existence of a 44-network.' The target's own second countercondition concedes that non-existence would be a better explanation, yet the claim is framed as if the disconnected-component structure is the explanation, with no simulation to separate the two.
